title: ERGo: Energy-Efficient Hybrid Graph Neural Network Training on Processing-In-Memory Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2611.17478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Processing-in-memory (PIM) has been proposed as an alternative computing paradigm for training Deep Neural Networks, including Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Despite these advancements, training GNN workloads on PIM devices necessitates off-chip memory access. This off-chip access is expensive in terms of performance and energy, thereby impacting the overall energy efficiency of the training process on PIM platforms. In this paper, we propose a novel hybrid training framework called ERGo that automatically switches from a full-parameter phase to a parameter-efficient phase during the training process with negligible loss in predictive accuracy. The parameter-efficient phase employs low-rank representations of GNN weights, effectively reducing the number of trainable parameters. This helps in reducing the off-chip access during the end-to-end training process on PIM architectures, leading to notable improvements in both performance and ene

translated_title: ERGo：基于存内计算架构的高能效混合图神经网络训练
translated_abstract: 存内计算已被提出作为训练深度神经网络（包括图神经网络）的替代计算范式。尽管取得了这些进展，在PIM设备上训练GNN工作负载仍需要进行片外内存访问。这种片外访问在性能和能耗方面的代价高昂，从而影响了PIM平台上训练过程的整体能效。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为ERGo的新型混合训练框架，它能在训练过程中自动从全参数阶段切换到参数高效阶段，且预测准确率的损失可以忽略不计。参数高效阶段采用GNN权重的低秩表示，有效减少了可训练参数的数量。这有助于减少在PIM架构上进行端到端训练过程中的片外访问，从而在性能和能效方面带来显著提升。
tldr: 提出混合训练框架ERGo，在训练过程中自动从全参数阶段切换到基于低秩表示的参数高效阶段，从而减少PIM架构上的片外内存访问，显著提升GNN训练的性能与能效。
en_tdlr: ERGo is a hybrid training framework that automatically switches from full-parameter training to a parameter-efficient phase using low-rank GNN weight representations, reducing off-chip memory accesses on PIM architectures and significantly improving both performance and energy efficiency.
